rationale:
Evidence. Iteration 6 (kd 0.30, y 0.05, wide span x = -0.07 to 0.07 m, base_speed 1.1, kp 2.0, ki 0.4, last_direction) is the best raced design so far at 38.64. Every trial still ended off_track with 0 finishes. max_error is 0.0602 on oval, 0.0613 on s-bend and 0.0648 on slalom, so it is still at or just above the 0.06 m limit. Progress is low (oval 0.115, s-bend 0.052, slalom 0.108). Steering oscillation stayed at 0.071 to 0.074 on oval and s-bend, but was 0.145 on slalom, where line loss also recurred (0.8 events per trial). Across iterations 0 to 6, max_error has stayed pinned at 0.060 to 0.065 across changes to kp, kd (0.05 to 0.30), ki, sensor size, span, speed and y. The feedback loop is therefore not the main lever.

Change. Following the approved contingency (max_error stays near 0.061 at kd 0.30, and oscillation on oval and s-bend is at most 0.10), I keep kd = 0.30 and all geometry and gains unchanged, and change only controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_right. No iteration has tested a fixed search direction, and slalom still loses the line with last_direction. search_right sets the signal to +1, which steers the robot left, so this tests whether recovering toward the left side of the tape helps. Direction is a best guess; if the result is worse, search_left (the other direction) is the next single-variable test.

Expected result. line_loss_events on slalom should fall toward 0 and max_error should fall toward 0.06 or below on slalom and s-bend. Progress should rise above 0.052 on s-bend. Risk: a fixed search direction may turn the robot the wrong way after a loss, which would raise max_error on the tracks that lose the line.

Hypotheses. H1: a fixed search direction (search_right) recovers slalom line loss, and max_error falls below 0.06 there. H2: max_error stays at 0.061 or higher on s-bend regardless of line_loss, which would point to the start transient or the motor mismatch. Measurements wanted: max_error and line_loss_events per track to test H1, and progress and steering_oscillation to check that the search direction does not add jitter.
